name: Synchronization Lead
description: SF Connect sync — pulls all Lead records from Salesforce CRM into Lead_Salesforce synchronized DE in HQ. Runs every 15 min.

name: Synchronization Contact
description: SF Connect sync — pulls all Contact records from Salesforce CRM into Contact_Salesforce synchronized DE in HQ. Runs every 15 min.

name: Segmentation
description: Parent BU automation — SQL query builds Parent_All_Leads from Lead_Salesforce, then Filtered DEs split by journey type (New, Hot_Lead, Prospect, NDA, NDA_Signed, PPT_Booked). Runs every 15 min.

steps.name: Parent_Segment
steps.description: Builds the master Parent_All_Leads DE from Lead_Salesforce

name: Subscribers Update
description: HQ child automation — joins Lead/Contact/Account Salesforce objects into Demo_Subscribers DE, then splits by region into shared DEs (SO, NO, EA, WE). Runs every 15 min after Segmentation.

steps.name: Student_Leads
steps.description: Builds Demo_Subscribers from student leads via SQL join
steps.query: SELECT ContactKey, EmailAddress, FirstName, LastName, Record_Type, Student_Type, Status, Status_in_LG, Demo_Date, FollowUpCallDate, CalMeetingDate, CalPPTDate, CalName, Region FROM Lead_Salesforce

steps.name: Student_Contacts
steps.query: SELECT ContactKey, EmailAddress, FirstName, LastName, Record_Type, Student_Type, Status, Status_in_LG, Demo_Date, FollowUpCallDate, CalMeetingDate, CalPPTDate, CalName, Region FROM Contact_Salesforce

steps.name: South_Subscribers
steps.description: Filters South records into shared DE for South child BU
steps.query: SELECT * FROM Demo_Subscribers WHERE Region = 'South'

steps.name: North_Subscribers
steps.description: Filters North records into shared DE for North child BU
steps.query: SELECT * FROM Demo_Subscribers WHERE Region = 'North'

steps.name: East_Subscribers
steps.description: Filters East records into shared DE for East child BU
steps.query: SELECT * FROM Demo_Subscribers WHERE Region = 'East'

steps.name: West_Subscribers
steps.description: Filters West records into shared DE for West child BU
steps.query: SELECT * FROM Demo_Subscribers WHERE Region = 'West'

name: South Segments
description: South child BU — SQL builds South_All_Leads from shared DE, then segment queries populate all journey entry DEs. Runs every 15 min.

steps.name: South_All_Leads
steps.query: SELECT * FROM SO_Shared

steps.name: Demo_Lesson_New
steps.query: SELECT * FROM South_All_Leads WHERE Status = 'New' AND Student_Type = 'Lead' AND Record_Type = 'Student'

steps.name: Demo_Follow_UP_Call
steps.query: SELECT * FROM South_All_Leads WHERE Student_Type IN ('Lead','Contact') AND Record_Type = 'Student' AND DATEDIFF(day, GETDATE(), FollowUpCallDate) = 1

steps.name: Demo_Lesson_Pending_Demo
steps.query: SELECT * FROM South_All_Leads WHERE Status = 'Pending Demo' AND Student_Type = 'Lead' AND Record_Type = 'Student'

steps.name: Demo_Lesson_Pending_Reminder
steps.query: SELECT * FROM South_All_Leads WHERE Status = 'Pending Demo' AND DATEDIFF(day, GETDATE(), Demo_Date) = 1

steps.name: Demo_Lesson_Attend_Demo
steps.query: SELECT * FROM South_All_Leads WHERE Status_in_LG = 'Done Demo' AND Student_Type = 'Contact' AND Record_Type = 'Student'

steps.name: Demo_Lesson_No_Show_Demo
steps.query: SELECT * FROM South_All_Leads WHERE Status = 'No Show' AND Record_Type = 'Student'

steps.name: Franchisee_Leads_New
steps.query: SELECT * FROM South_All_Leads WHERE Status = 'New' AND Record_Type = 'Franchisee'

steps.name: Franchisee_Leads_Follow_Up_Call
steps.query: SELECT * FROM South_All_Leads WHERE Record_Type = 'Franchisee' AND DATEDIFF(day, GETDATE(), FollowUpCallDate) = 1

steps.name: Franchisee_Leads_Prospect
steps.query: SELECT * FROM South_All_Leads WHERE Status = 'Prospect' AND Record_Type = 'Franchisee'

steps.name: Franchisee_Leads_Prospect_Reminder
steps.query: SELECT * FROM South_All_Leads WHERE Status = 'Prospect' AND Record_Type = 'Franchisee' AND DATEDIFF(day, GETDATE(), FollowUpCallDate) = 1

steps.name: Franchisee_Leads_NDA_Signed
steps.query: SELECT * FROM South_All_Leads WHERE Status = 'NDA Signed' AND Record_Type = 'Franchisee'

steps.name: Franchisee_Leads_PPT_Booked
steps.query: SELECT * FROM South_All_Leads WHERE Record_Type = 'Franchisee' AND CalPPTDate IS NOT NULL

steps.name: Franchisee_Leads_PPTBooked_Reminder
steps.query: SELECT * FROM South_All_Leads WHERE Record_Type = 'Franchisee' AND DATEDIFF(day, GETDATE(), CalPPTDate) = 1

name: North Segmentation
description: North child BU — SQL builds North_All_Leads from shared DE, then segment queries populate all journey entry DEs. Runs every 15 min.

steps.name: North_All_Leads
steps.query: SELECT * FROM NO_Shared

name: East Segments
description: East child BU — SQL builds East_All_Leads from shared DE, then segment queries populate all journey entry DEs. Runs every 15 min.

steps.name: East_All_Leads
steps.query: SELECT * FROM EA_Shared
